kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتسم (form VIII)
# نَقْتَسِمُ (naqtasimu) /naq.ta.si.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
# نَقْتَسِمَ (naqtasima) /naq.ta.si.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
# نَقْتَسِمْ (naqtasim) /naq.ta.sim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
